title: The park's spent-window card calls a window ended by Stop, pause or control-disable "spent"
outcome:
engram_admission_window_spent (w-ac230a24d0d8) is also true when the lineage window has ended, which a Stop, an operator pause or control disabled does while the deadline is still ahead. The park then writes the spent-window disposition ("the admission window from X to Y is spent after N attempts"), so a Stop-ended window is described as exhausted, for example when an in-flight attempt parks after a Stop. The state is right; the wording is wrong.
Fix: word the hold by cause (ended versus deadline passed). The card wording at the park belongs to w-260d2528bc15 (Coder), which replaces w-ac230's placeholder; EngramSpentWindow can carry an ended-versus-deadline flag for it.
acceptance: The park's spent-window card calls a window ended by Stop, pause or control-disable "spent" is done
